arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Simpson argued that a jury acquittal is final under double jeopardy law.
Mr. Petrany argued that Georgia law voids verdicts with contradictory findings.
Justice Alito asked if judges should instruct juries to deliberate further on inconsistencies.
